statements.status_notes: CVE-2025-8732: a libxml2 SGML catalog that contains a CATALOG directive pointing to itself makes xmlParseSGMLCatalog() and xmlExpandCatalog() call each other without bound until the stack overflows (https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/libxml2/-/issues/958). It needs an untrusted SGML catalog, which Debian rates as negligible security impact, but upstream fixed it in https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/libxml2/-/commit/3425dece47c8db600f8d7328ae2d7ddfaa0d7b2d, released in libxml2 2.15.2, by passing a recursion depth to xmlExpandCatalog(). The DHI libxml2 packages for Alpine 3.23 are builds of libxml2 2.13.9 (2.13.9-r0, 2.13.9-r1 and 2.13.9-r2) from Alpine's libxml2 recipe, which carries no fix for this CVE; Alpine's tracker lists libxml2 2.13.9 as not fixed (https://security.alpinelinux.org/vuln/CVE-2025-8732). In catalog.c of the libxml2 2.13.9 release, xmlParseSGMLCatalog() still calls xmlExpandCatalog() with no depth argument, and on both x86_64 and aarch64 the xmlcatalog program of every one of these builds crashes with a segmentation fault when given an SGML catalog whose CATALOG entry points to itself, so every published build is affected.

CVE-2025-8732: a libxml2 SGML catalog that contains a CATALOG directive pointing to itself makes xmlParseSGMLCatalog() and xmlExpandCatalog() call each other without bound until the stack overflows (https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/libxml2/-/issues/958). It needs an untrusted SGML catalog, which Debian rates as negligible security impact, but upstream fixed it in https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/libxml2/-/commit/3425dece47c8db600f8d7328ae2d7ddfaa0d7b2d, released in libxml2 2.15.2, by passing a recursion depth to xmlExpandCatalog(). Debian fixed it for trixie in libxml2 2.12.7+dfsg+really2.9.14-2.1+deb13u3, whose changelog reads "Fix CVE-2025-8732: When a catalog file contains a CATALOG directive pointing to itself, `xmlExpandCatalog()` and `xmlParseSGMLCatalog()` recursively call each other without bounds" (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2025-8732). The DHI libxml2 packages for Debian 13 are rebuilds of Debian's trixie libxml2. The rebuilds of 2.12.7+dfsg+really2.9.14-2.1+deb13u2 predate the fix; the first rebuild of 2.12.7+dfsg+really2.9.14-2.1+deb13u3, used as the fixed version here, and every later build are built from that Debian release, and the Debian changelog shipped in the current libxml2 package (read for amd64 and arm64) carries Debian's entry for this CVE. The same self-referencing SGML catalog that crashes the Alpine builds is rejected without a crash by the xmlcatalog program of the current Debian 13 build on amd64 and arm64.
